before.title: 3Blue1Brown — ch. 3, “Linear transformations and matrices”
before.why: 1.3 warned you this video was describing something else. This is the something else. One sentence to take away: the columns are where the basis vectors land.

before.title: 3Blue1Brown — ch. 4, “Matrix multiplication as composition”
before.why: Watch it before exercise 6 rather than after. Doing one transformation and then another is itself a transformation, and the order of the product reads backwards from the order of the actions.

after.title: 3Blue1Brown — “But what is a neural network?”
after.why: Only once exercise 7 passes. The circles and arrows are a matrix, a bias and a squashing function — and you will have written two of the three.
